$comment: The nineteen demo cases of the underwriting desk. The desk lists the newest case first, so the file is written last to first. Everything is invented: Thornmere Mutual Insurance, its brokers, its insureds, its submissions, its referrals, its policies and its claims. Every id, date and amount is what the invented insurer returns when it is started with the date 26 November 2026.

cases.title: Merrowdown Marine Stores: renewal
cases.broker: Quillfeather & Roe Insurance Brokers, Port Ilvane
cases.text:
THE RENEWAL
Renewal: RNW-6706
Policy: CPL-6806
Insured: Merrowdown Marine Stores Ltd
Class: Commercial property
Insured item: Warehouse and shop for boat engines and marine paint.
Period: 14 Jan 2026 to 13 Jan 2027
Premium: USD 12,500.00
Sum insured: USD 1,000,000.00 in total
Deductible: USD 2,500.00
Broker: Quillfeather & Roe Insurance Brokers, Port Ilvane
Claims: CCL-6905, CCL-6906
THE AGENT'S TASK
The agent sets the expiring terms beside the claims of the period and the changes in the risk, and marks which renewal rule each finding touches. It renews nothing, quotes nothing and offers no terms. The underwriter decides the terms, a senior underwriter where a rule asks for a referral, and the claims team settles a point on which two records disagree. Everything here is as the underwriting system holds it. The agent reads the renewal itself from the underwriting system.
